name: experience-navigation-accessibility
objective: Make every field-related entry, route, deep link, notification action, page, tab, control, state, and recovery path clear, accessible, bound, and convergent across all surfaces.
truthOwner: Identity/Workforce/DSH/WLT according to canonical domain ownership; surfaces are presentation and composition only.

tasks.objective: Audit and correct every entry, deep link, notification action, initial URL, resumed URL, back/cancel/resume path, tab, stack transition, and invalid parameter path across surfaces.
tasks.currentProblem: Existing evidence is distributed and does not yet prove one authoritative end-to-end result across all required surfaces and all twenty-four slices.
tasks.requiredChange: Audit and correct every entry, deep link, notification action, initial URL, resumed URL, back/cancel/resume path, tab, stack transition, and invalid parameter path across surfaces.
tasks.targetState: Every entry is permission-gated, parameter-validated, recoverable, and produces consistent back/readback behavior.
tasks.action: Inspect the pinned code, update canonical truth and shared layers first, migrate every affected consumer, remove parallel or dead paths, then execute linked checks and cross-surface readback.
mustNotChange: Do not create a surface-local source of product, assignment, partner, store, catalog, status, or financial truth.
Do not execute or close one journey or one slice independently from required cross-surface effects.
Do not bypass generated contracts, server authorization, DSH operational ownership, or WLT financial ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: Every entry is permission-gated, parameter-validated, recoverable, and produces consistent back/readback behavior.
All five surfaces have documented direct or indirect impact and verified visible readback or evidenced non-participation.
Success, denial, failure, conflict, offline, unknown-result, refresh, and restart outcomes are tested where applicable.
tasks.rollback: Revert the stage commit or disable its governed rollout while preserving forward-compatible data and evidence; never roll back by restoring a parallel truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused commit for U003 after canonical changes, consumer migration, cleanup, and required checks pass.
